description: Widths desktop Hangul 2024 (Windows, 13.0.0.653) needed for synthetic EqEdit scripts, measured 2026-11-13. Each script was set alone between two bars in a box far wider than itself and the page drawn at 300 dpi; needed_width (HWPUNIT) is the distance from where the box starts to the right edge of the equation ink, less the 56-unit margin. One pixel is 24 units. Sets: glyphs (runs of one letter, a T b for each operator), pieces, school (school notation), mac-corpus (the scripts of equation_hancom_boxes.json), held-out (not used when the tables were fitted, at 1000/1100/1300), sizes (14 held-out scripts at eleven base sizes). Rows with font HancomEQN were measured the same way with the equation's font attribute set to HancomEQN (the font Hangul's own equation editor writes): the glyph battery at 1100 and the school and held-out scripts at 1000 and 1100.
